scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run preview:check
scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings . && shellcheck scripts/*.sh examples/*.sh .husky/pre-commit .husky/pre-push && actionlint
scripts.format: biome format --write . && prettier --write '**/*.{md,yml,yaml}' && nixfmt flake.nix && shfmt -w scripts/*.sh examples/*.sh .husky/pre-commit .husky/pre-push
scripts.format:check: biome format . && prettier --check '**/*.{md,yml,yaml}' && nixfmt --check flake.nix && shfmt -d scripts/*.sh examples/*.sh .husky/pre-commit .husky/pre-push
